summary: Tested new features end-to-end: expenses date-range filter, salary advance repay endpoint & ledger impact, and user management (owner-only). Backend: 9/9 pytest tests passed. Frontend: expenses preset buttons + custom date range change filter counts; ledger toggle expands advance entries and repay button toggles net-payable correctly (97,000 → 105,000 → 97,000 on undo); Team page lists users with correct role badges, self-owner shows only Demote (no Remove), accountant is blocked from /team (redirected) and has no nav-team link. All edge cases pass: non-advance repay → 400, non-existent repay → 404, owner self-delete → 400, accountant GET /users → 403.

issues: Minor: 'All time' preset button is not visually active by default (no preset value initially set), so quick-range buttons only highlight after first click. Cosmetic only.

critical_code_review_comments: Expenses.jsx: initial filter state lacks preset:'all'; default UI shows no active preset button until user clicks. Non-blocking.

Users.jsx: Client-side check for last-owner demotion only counts self; if demoting another owner leaves 0 owners, backend does not prevent it. Consider server-side safeguard: reject PUT /users/{id}/role when it would leave zero owners.
server.py: /api/expenses date filter uses string comparison ($gte/$lte) which works because YYYY-MM-DD is lexicographically ordered — safe, but noted.

server.py: DELETE /api/users allows removing the last remaining owner (only self-delete is blocked). Could lock out admin access if two owners delete each other. Recommend server-side 'at least one owner' guard.
